name: KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: Signed 32-bit identifier of the request. Must be unique within the message.

fields.name: suggested_username
fields.description: Suggested username for the bot. The username must end with “bot”. If the user creating the bot has a Telegram Premium subscription, then the username can also end with “agent”, “ai”, “app”, “game”, or “gay”; in this case, the username will be assigned to the bot as a secondary username, and a regular username ending with “bot” will be assigned to the bot automatically.

description: This object defines the parameters for the creation of a managed bot. Information about the created bot will be shared with the bot using the update managed_bot and a Message with the field managed_bot_created.
